_note: Inviting friends is how you get rich. Money the game creates pays `factor` of its amount (wages, games, bounties, the mystery box, season and goal rewards, the marathon, the passport, profit share, Locals' gifts, ...), except refs starting with one of `fullPay`: invites and Big Missions, house parties, new-player rewards, and money that comes from another player (services, tickets, race pots and bets, a car sold back). Social rewards pay in full only for `socialFullPay` kinds. Transfers between players and refunds are never touched. Enforced by coin_move / pay_social_reward (earn_rule() mirrors this file, checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs).
